notes.title: Patch 0.11.0
notes.notes: [h2]0.11.0[/h2][p][/p][p][b][i]This is a major update so previous saves will be invalidated[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Changed[/h3][list][*][p]Books are now "Undiscovered" by default and will reveal the name once you have purchased them. This counts towards progression.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Added[/h3][list][*][p]Some steam achievments have been added, but not all of them are completely hooked up yet.[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty levels are now unlocked after a win in a run[/p][p][b]Stat tracking! [/b]Total Words scored, Total Unique words scored, Runs won on each difficulty,More to come![/p][/*][*][p][b]Books View:[/b] Check out the progression menu to see what books you have available to you and how to unlock new ones.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Cloud saves!!![/b]A long requested feature, is now added and working for cross platform/cross device saves. Now you can pick up your run on the steamdeck/work laptop/smart fridge as long as it runs steam :)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list][*][p]New words played are now correctly tracked and stored in each profile (No green popup on every word now :))[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Frost river tooltip not having purple text for editable values[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Tale of Jazqix not having purple text for editable values[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed word helper labels persisting after changing the word in the tray while using The Sidecar[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed E Reader not ranomizing after trials[/p][/*][*][p]Various E Reader Interactions (Mimicry)[/p][/*][*][p]Various Mimicry Interactions (Scrapbook, Treasure Archipelago)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance[/h3][list][*][p]Alliteration[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Increased Amp from 9 > 12[/p][/*][/list][p]Celsius 233[/p][list][*][p]Increased Starting & Increase Marks to 40 each[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.4
notes.notes: [h2]0.9.4[/h2][p][/p][h3]Added[/h3][p]New Trial Locations[/p][list][*][p]A mysterious cave with glowing crystals[/p][/*][*][p]A musty alleyway[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changed[/h3][list][*][p]Changed Thesaurus base marks to 3 from 5. notes.notes: [h2]0.9.3[/h2][p][/p][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when trying to use a glitch piece [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed glitch pieces not showing their symbol[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed swapping 2 of the same letters on the board not updating the board state[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer pause the game during a scene transition[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.6.0
notes.notes: [h1]Demo Patch 0.6.0 - Bugfixes, Visual Polish, New Dictionary[/h1][p]*Old save files will be invalidated*[/p][p][/p][h3]Added [/h3][p]- Tutorial is now automatically checked on your first launch of the game[/p][p]- New Bigram Tag on pieces[/p][p]- New text on carver encounter to let you know you can carve a bigram[/p][p]- New visuals for hand [/p][p]- New visuals & sfx for tray (hoping this will help people realize you can't put pieces back in the tray)[/p][p]- New fireworks animation on win/round win[/p][p][/p][h3]Changed[/h3][p]- Improved Options -> Main Menu -> Exit Flow. Should be harder to accidentally quit the game now[/p][p]- Word helper labels now have arrows point in the direction of the word[/p][p]- New Discard system. You can now discard piece when you are out discards to immediately apply the penalty. Drag and drop pieces onto the bag to discard them. [/p][p]- New dictionary & Watchword filter (you can spell some swears now) More details are in the community Discord Server[/p][p][/p][h3]Bugfixes[/h3][p]- Hopefully a fix for those seemingly random crashes when clicking on the Portal to go to the next trial. [/p][p]- Duplicated metal pieces no longer "cross wires" and correctly swap independently[/p][p]- Fixed buttons being focused when pressing "Tab" to toggle the Word Helper View[/p][p]- Fixed a crash when you entered the greedy watchguard with enough money to completely pay him off[/p][p]- Fixed a crash after you buy & sell E-Reader[/p][p]- Fixed a weird shadow on the main tray[/p][p]- Fixed some of the level BG particles from not emitting[/p][p]- Fixed bug where an extreme high or negative score would make the trial total shake crazily[/p][p]- Fixed patient Watchguard tooltip to include lowering draws per turn to 1[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where getting 2 duplicate/destroy curses would leave an empty slot unable to be filled[/p][p][/p][h3]Balance [/h3][p]- Legendary and Mythic drops are more rare[/p][p]- Leafy house Rarity: Legendary => Mythic[/p][p]- Buffed Wldstrm from 3 Marks => 5 Marks[/p][p]- Torchbearer Rarity: Rare => Legendary[/p]
